remarks: Your chance to own in one of Norwalk's most popular complexes. Conveniently located for easy commuting, shopping and recreation. This pristine 1 bedroom is move in ready. Crisp, clean, light filled, and ready for your personal touches to make it your perfect home. Spacious living room/dining combo with hard wood like laminate floors, which is open to the modern kitchen with white cabinets, granite counters and newer stainless appliances. Large bedroom features walk in closet and sliders to the good size patio for maximum outdoor time. Enjoy the many amenities of the complex including 2 pools, club house with gym, tennis and pickle ball courts and plenty of trees and flowers to enhance any time spent walking, running or just hanging out with friends. Unpack and smile!
